name: tvcli
postCreateCommand: go build -o tvcli ./cmd/tvcli && [ -x "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" ] || curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash && for f in "$HOME/.profile" "$HOME/.bashrc"; do grep -qs 'opencode/bin' "$f" 2>/dev/null || printf 'export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH"\n' >> "$f"; done
